sources.name: arXiv quantitative finance (all q-fin subcategories)
sources.notes: Aggregate feed covers q-fin.PM/TR/ST/CP/RM/PR/MF/EC/GN. Updates daily ~midnight ET.

sources.name: arXiv stat.ML (machine learning / time-series methods)
sources.notes: Higher volume than q-fin; the relevance screen carries the load. cs.LG deliberately excluded (volume too high for precision) - revisit if stat.ML proves thin.

sources.name: Quantocracy (quant blog aggregator)
sources.notes: Links out to third-party posts; linked domains off-watchlist go to the discovery queue, the aggregator item itself is screened on title.

sources.name: Alpha Architect blog
sources.notes: Factor investing research summaries; usually quote-grounded claims.

sources.name: Robot Wealth blog
sources.notes: Practitioner trading research.

sources.name: Rob Carver - Investment Idiocy
sources.notes: Atom feed. Systematic futures, position sizing, portfolio construction.

sources.name: Quantpedia blog (free articles)
sources.notes: Free tier only; premium strategy database is paywalled and never fetched.

sources.name: The Financial Hacker
sources.notes: Low post frequency; algorithmic strategy dissections.

sources.name: Quantifiable Edges
sources.notes: Short-horizon equity index edges.

sources.name: Newfound Research - Flirting with Models
sources.notes: Trend, rebalance timing luck, return stacking.

sources.name: SSRN new papers - NOT AUTOMATABLE (see notes; Coen decision at checkpoint)
sources.notes: Researched 2026-08-15: SSRN offers NO public per-eJournal RSS (rankings feeds retired; metadata feeds are institutional-contract only), and papers.ssrn.com 403s scripted fetches at the CDN (bot protection - evasion out of contract scope). Options: (a) retire this entry - SSRN papers reach us indirectly via Quantocracy/blog links (discovery queue) and arXiv q-fin overlap; (b) future: subscribe to FEN eJournal email announcements (free) and add an IMAP ingest, Tier 3 decision. Entry stays unverified/unpollable until Coen picks.

sources.name: Federal Reserve FEDS working papers
sources.notes: Finance and Economics Discussion Series - research with mechanism, not press noise.

sources.name: Federal Reserve monetary policy press releases
sources.notes: FOMC statements / implementation notes. Screen bar: keep only items with testable market-behavior implications; mechanism-free macro news is a kill category.

sources.name: NY Fed Liberty Street Economics
sources.notes: Microstructure, funding markets, dealer positioning research.

sources.name: BIS working papers
sources.notes: Cross-market structure and FX research.

sources.name: RBA media releases
sources.notes: AU jurisdiction relevance. Same mechanism bar as fed-monetary-press.

sources.name: microsoft/qlib releases
sources.notes: AI-for-quant platform; release notes surface new factor/model research.
